identification: Box of 5 framed prints. (1) Two framed Lionel Lindsay giclee reproductions: 'The Witch' (black cat among blossom, 1924 wood engraving, no. 28 pencilled, 131/275 in the Littlewood signature line) and a cat/kitten and magpie wood engraving; both carry 'Statement of Authenticity ... edition of 275 Giclee prints numbered and signed by the Lionel Lindsay scholar and publisher Robert C. Littlewood', reproduced with National Library of Australia permission. They are modern reproductions signed by the publisher, not by Lindsay. (2) Framed print of Lindsay's 'King Billy' portrait with same Littlewood-style copyright text and signature. (3) Small colour lithograph of an outback cricket game in a dark frame, pencil mark at lower right reading roughly 'Pro Hart' (hard to read, possibly proof/annotation); style is Broken Hill Pro Hart but unconfirmed. (4) Gilt-framed reproduction of two kittens in a basket (decorative print).

viewing_check: Estimate $40-70, bid $25 (+22% premium). The Lindsay giclees are modern reproductions (edition 275, signed by the publisher, not Lindsay); pair sold A$180 at Danielle Elizabeth Apr 2024 and a single small one A$80 at Lawsons Jul 2026, so roughly $40-100 each at auction, not rising. Check at viewing: is the Pro Hart litho truly hand-signed in pencil (and does it read Pro Hart) or just a printed/annotated plate; if hand-signed with edition number it may be $150-250, if mass offset only $60. Frame sizes and glass condition (one frame has a glass crack/reflective line). Prices mostly 1-2 years old, flat.
